title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.3 V. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium fluoride (LiF). The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The median particle diameter D50 is 0.5 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the all-solid-state lithium battery. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The cathode delivering 1400 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The active material iron sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based all-solid-state battery is described. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The material comprises lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. Nickel accounts for 60 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The LiNbO3, Li3InCl6, and Li2ZrO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The disclosure is applicable to lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and has an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm and a coverage of 85% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The high coverage of the coating results in improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 40 nm to 200 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 300 cycles of stable plating and stripping. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The Li3PS4 and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The Li3N layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the ceramic ion conductor. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The suppression of filament penetration results in a longer cycle life and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 75 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.2 micrometers to 20 micrometers.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 90% or more and an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm is provided. The Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A 8 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid in which part of the bromine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiBr to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 3.5 mS/cm. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which titanium disulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The active material titanium disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. The confinement of titanium disulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ion-conductive solid whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 20 cm3/g or less. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 60% or more are obtained. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved moisture stability and sinterability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 10 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Argyrodite sulfide ceramic ion conductor with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and method for preparing the same
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for a lithium secondary battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Firing is performed at 500 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.15 or less. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the electrochemical window of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyacrylic acid binder
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; lithium sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a titanium disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The cathode delivering 1000 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, vinylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The capacity retention of 85% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.
