title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 75:25 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The solid electrolyte may comprise argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant niobium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing Li2O. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 1.2 mS/cm. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a beta-Li3PS4 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved ionic conductivity and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the content of Li2O is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tungstate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tungstate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The Li2ZrO3 and Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li3InCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The high coverage of the coating results in improved interfacial resistance at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 40 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a lithium fluoride-containing additive layer
abstract: Provided is a solid-state cell in which lithium fluoride is added at the lithium metal interface in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% to suppress dendrites. The additive comprises lithium fluoride in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The LiF, Li3YCl6, and Li3PS4 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.7% after 100 cycles. The lithium fluoride additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. Specific examples are lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and beta-Li3PS4. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% or more, and wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Described is a combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. With 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a self-supporting solid electrolyte film produced by powder-to-film rolling and calendering. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 2 mS/cm. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more, and wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 30 degrees C to 90 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting nitrogen oxide
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The capacity retention of 85% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which molybdenum disulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The cathode delivering 1000 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising molybdenum disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 5.2 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The oxidation potential is 5.2 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 2 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, LLTO, and LLZO material. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. With 2 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The capacity retention of 92% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using ethyl propionate and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. The ion-conductive solid obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.5 wt%. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. A solid-state battery comprising the Li7P3S11 and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 40 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of erbium and titanium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ceramic ion conductor in which titanium is substituted for part of the erbium in a lithium erbium bromide framework. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ErBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C. When z is 0.1, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.3 V. Specific examples are Li3InCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The Li3InCl6 and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved high-voltage stability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which erbium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: UNIVERSITY OF SELEXEN INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: UNIVERSITY OF SELEXEN INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Dendrite-suppressing indium additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns an additive that alloys with lithium during plating and prevents short circuit through the ceramic ion conductor. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. An all-solid-state lithium battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ceramic ion conductor shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The cell shows no short circuit for 500 cycles at 1 mA/cm2 and 1 mAh/cm2 under a stack pressure of 2 MPa. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the all-solid-state lithium battery. A stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the all-solid-state lithium battery. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing GeS2. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 4 mS/cm. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase precipitates uniformly. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 5 mg/cm2. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 800 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; iron sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium difluorophosphate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The capacity retention of 85% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a solid electrolyte layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The polymer layer comprises polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 material. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more and the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers. The suppression of filament penetration results in a longer cycle life and improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium phosphorus oxynitride (LiPON) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.3% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide solid electrolyte whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 40 cm3/g or less. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1 mS/cm and a retention of 90% after humid exposure. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a silicon substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 650 to 800 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tungsten stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The LLTO and Li2ZrO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The sintered body has a relative density of 96%, an average grain size of 10 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The LLTO and Li2ZrO3 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the high-voltage stability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, fluoroethylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. With 1 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The suspension concentration is 5 wt%, the reaction temperature is 60 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 120 degrees C. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the ionic conductivity of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiNbO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The LLZO material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The coating layer has an average thickness of 15 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. Specific examples are Li7P3S11. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. An ionic conductivity of 2.6 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a Li7P3S11 phase and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 50%. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material. The precipitated Li7P3S11 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. The ceramic ion conductor shows improved moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. A capacitance of 330 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable thio-LISICON crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 70%. After heat treatment at 260 degrees C for 5 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 5.5 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The glass phase contains Li2O in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the thio-LISICON phase. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the content of Li2O is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNbO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 15 nm. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm.
