An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ceramic ion conductor with reduced grain boundary resistance and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ceramic ion conductor doped with tungsten and sintered with Li3BO3 is described. A lithium excess of 8 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The sintered body has a relative density of 94%, an average grain size of 5 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LLZO and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein 0.1 <= v <= 0.45, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using tetrahydrofuran and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The suspension concentration is 5 wt%, the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 200 degrees C. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the ionic conductivity of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor in which part of the bromine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiBr and Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The mixed halogen substitution improves the ionic conductivity of the all-solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 90% or more and an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm is provided. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. Suitable compositions include Li3InCl6, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the high-voltage stability. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 800 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium carbonate that converts the oxygen concentration into an ionic activity. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor detects oxygen with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 40 cm3/g or less. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The oxygen content of 4 mol% to 16 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 40 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 1.6 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ceramic ion conductor shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 100 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. With zirconium substitution of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for sulfur dioxide with improved response time
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to sulfur dioxide against interfering gases. The sulfur dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects sulfur dioxide.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition for lithium battery
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte stable against oxidation above 5.2 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5.2 V. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide solid electrolyte. A Li6PS5X sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. The capacitor rated at 25 V may be used in a charging circuit for a lithium ion battery. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

title: sulfur positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The active material sulfur is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for oxygen with improved response time
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Method for producing a solid electrolyte sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a solid electrolyte is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The slurry has a solid content of 40 wt% to 60 wt% and a viscosity of 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 700 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of sulfur dioxide concentration at 700 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of sulfur dioxide.

assignee_raw: Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation of Seodam National University
assignee_db_group: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY
title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25 and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated therein. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. After heat treatment at 320 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 4 mS/cm. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The ceramic ion conductor shows improved cycle life and moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the content of Li2O is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using ethyl acetate and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A precursor of the LLZO, Li7P3S11, and LATP material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 5 mS/cm. A solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to a solid-state lithium battery comprising the same. The solid electrolyte may comprise argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. A solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The material is useful as a solid electrolyte layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and carbon nanotubes and lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The cathode delivering 1000 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises molybdenum disulfide impregnated in carbon nanotubes and a carbon coating on the composite. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; molybdenum disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

assignee_raw: Hwaseol Natl Research Inst of Energy Materials
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATL RESEARCH INST OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Dendrite-suppressing zinc additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa with a zinc additive. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. Suitable compositions include Li3YCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The material comprises Li3YCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the electronic conductivity of the solid electrolyte layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. A Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% or more and a critical current density of 1.5 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. The alloy formation lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 60 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 0.4 MPa to 10 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98.2% or more.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a lanthanum fluoride solid electrolyte for detecting oxygen
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of oxygen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for oxygen. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The coated particles are heat-treated at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 80% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tungstate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is an ion-conductive solid comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable thio-LISICON crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 4 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The GeS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The roll pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Tin-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and production method thereof
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which hydrolysis is suppressed by tin substitution is provided. The tin content of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 40 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 0.7 mS/cm or more. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Suitable compositions include lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the cycle life and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours is 80% or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobium tantalum oxide and to a method for producing the same. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 8 nm. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Specific examples are lithium niobate (LiNbO3), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li3InCl6. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. A lithium secondary battery using the coated active material shows improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte and to a lithium battery including the same. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The electrode mixture of the solid-state lithium battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The total ionic conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein 0.15 <= v <= 0.5.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polycarbonate based electrolyte of 50 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte stable against oxidation above 4.5 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin. The solid electrolyte is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. Part of the titanium in the perovskite-type LLTO phase is substituted by tin in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.49 mS/cm or more. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; molybdenum disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and zirconium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.2 V. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The oxidation stability limit is 4 V or more and the conductivity is 2.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 200 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 500 degrees C. The ceramic is NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 500 degrees C. The sensor detects nitrogen oxide with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
