assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATL RESEARCH INST OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. Suitable compositions include Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The content of Li2O is 3 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.3 mS/cm or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The glass phase contains Li2O in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the interfacial resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of Li2O is 0.6 mol% to 12 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 24 hours.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 8 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The capacitor rated at 25 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The polyaniline is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: Provided is a solid-state cell in which indium is added at the lithium metal interface in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% to suppress dendrites. The critical current density is 2.8 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The Li3YCl6 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. In an embodiment the material is Li3YCl6. The method prevents short circuit and improves the dendrite suppression and ionic conductivity without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 25 MPa.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with low residual solvent and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 4.1 mS/cm. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material. The solvent is acetonitrile, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a ceramic ion conductor with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor operating at 400 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for oxygen.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor by stirring the raw materials in tetrahydrofuran at 40 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. A residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6 and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a lithium yttrium bromide solid electrolyte prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3YCl6, LiF, and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.3 V versus Li/Li+. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved high-voltage stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.5, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; lithium sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3BO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3BO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 450 degrees C. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and lithium fluoride (LiF). An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and LiF material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The composition further comprises a lithium metal halide in which the chloride anion sublattice is close-packed, and the halide is synthesized together with the main phase. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm or more. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A precursor of the Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 4 wt% to 16 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte and to a lithium battery including the same. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. Sintering at 1200 degrees C with a lithium excess of 10 mol% gives a relative density of 97% and a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1000 degrees C to 1350 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium carbonate that converts the hydrogen concentration into an ionic activity. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen. The sensor detects hydrogen with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 500 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The polypyrrole is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte comprises a lithium metal layer, a solid electrolyte layer, and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. The cell shows no short circuit for 300 cycles at 1 mA/cm2 and 1 mAh/cm2 under a stack pressure of 5 MPa. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and lithium fluoride (LiF). The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 60 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 25 MPa.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The grain size is 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and the relative density is 92% or more after sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The dopant niobium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.1 to 0.45, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. In an embodiment the material is lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.1 <= v <= 0.45, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: Hafnium-substituted perovskite-type LLTO solid electrolyte stable above 4.5 V and method for preparing the same
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte stable against oxidation above 4.5 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.35 mS/cm or more. The positive electrode active material is LiCoPO4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide solid electrolyte. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The hafnium substitution suppresses titanium reduction and improves the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability in contact with lithium.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. A solid electrolyte of polyaniline replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ceramic ion conductor doped with tantalum and sintered with Al2O3 is described. When v is 0.25, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm. A sintering aid comprising Al2O3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the grain boundary resistance of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. Firing is performed at 480 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.12 or less. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and method for producing the same
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic argyrodite-type structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. An ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ceramic ion conductor whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-iodine substitution. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.12 or less. The Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. An ionic conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.1 to 1.5. The mixed halogen substitution improves the ionic conductivity of the all-solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick LiTaO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the all-solid-state battery. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The material comprises Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution for lithium battery
abstract: An ion-conductive solid comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and iodine. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The Li6PS5Cl and Li3PS4 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 50 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 5.5 mS/cm. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which precipitates a beta-Li3PS4 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and production method thereof
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm or more. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a lithium secondary battery. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: nickel sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which nickel sulfide is confined in the pores of carbon nanotubes to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ion-conductive solid in which part of the bromine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises lithium sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and to a method of handling it in a dry room. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 4.5 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a silicon substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for nitrogen oxide with improved response time
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which nitrogen oxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of nitrogen oxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: lithium sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 10 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The dopant tungsten occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1200 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm and a relative density of 92%. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The cathode delivering 1400 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The sulfur cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. Polysulfide dissolution from the sulfur cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
