The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and carbon nanotubes and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The molybdenum disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li7P3S11 phase and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 320 degrees C. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the solid-state lithium battery. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.3 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 60% or more are obtained. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a thio-LISICON phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing GeS2. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. After heat treatment at 240 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.8 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The polyaniline is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 100 microfarad rating. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by solution casting
abstract: This disclosure concerns a protective layer comprising an Al2O3 inorganic layer and a fluorinated polymer for a lithium metal negative electrode. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. The bilayer structure improves the sinterability and moisture stability compared with a single inorganic layer.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.3% or more.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which lithium sulfide is confined in the pores of porous carbon to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. A lithium-sulfur battery with the lithium sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; lithium sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy for lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. An ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.3 to 0.75. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer that has a solid content of 50 wt% to 70 wt% and a viscosity of 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ceramic ion conductor is improved. The LLZO, LATP, and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% to 70 wt% and a viscosity of 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The binder content of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt% gives a peel strength of 0.1 N/cm or more and a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the ceramic ion conductor, and the layer shows improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from 1,2-dimethoxyethane, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The suspension concentration is 15 wt%, the reaction temperature is 40 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 200 degrees C. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7P3S11. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li7P3S11 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 material. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, graphene, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. The sulfur is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The active material sulfur is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated therein. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS (HNRIEM)
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS HNRIEM
title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic Ag-C layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: Provided is a lithiophilic protective layer that improves the wettability of lithium and prevents direct contact between metallic lithium and the sulfide layer. The ion-conductive component may be Li3YCl6 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 500 cycles of stable plating and stripping. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Because the inorganic layer blocks electron leakage, the decomposition of the solid electrolyte at the negative electrode is suppressed and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.2% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 125 cycles or more.

title: Method for forming a solid electrolyte film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: Described is a solvent-free film of a solid electrolyte with a fibril network that gives a tensile strength of 0.6 MPa or more. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The binder content is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%, which gives a tensile strength of 1 MPa and a conductivity of 2 mS/cm. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The dry sheet is useful as a separator layer for roll-to-roll production, with improved interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 10% or less, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Hafnium-substituted perovskite-type LLTO ion-conductive solid stable above 4.8 V and lithium battery
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 4.8 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.8 V. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The positive electrode active material is LiCoPO4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ion-conductive solid. The oxide particles have a core of the perovskite-type LLTO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Solid electrolyte slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: A method for producing a solid electrolyte sheet by slurry casting, drying, and peeling from a support film is provided. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The solid content is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, the viscosity is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the solid electrolyte, and the layer shows improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The suspension has a solid concentration of 7.5 wt% to 30 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. The Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. After heat treatment at 240 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 3.1 mS/cm. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The Li2O addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the content of Li2O is 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The protective layer improves the durability of the sodium beta-alumina sensor in an exhaust gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising sodium beta-alumina, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The average thickness of the coating is 2 nm to 10 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The high coverage of the coating results in improved interfacial resistance at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. In an embodiment the material is lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. Heat treatment at 450 degrees C after drying at 180 degrees C gives a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm or more. The solvent is tetrahydrofuran, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The structure with the nickel-plated copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The oxygen substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The oxygen content of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 40 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 0.7 mS/cm or more. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the sinterability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ceramic ion conductor doped with tungsten and sintered with LiF is described. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LLTO and LATP material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. A sintering aid comprising LiF is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The grain size is 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers and the relative density is 94% or more after sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the high-voltage stability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 0 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. With 2 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Potentiometric nitrogen oxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The nitrogen oxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The sensor detects nitrogen oxide with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 400 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide solid electrolyte that does not require long mechanical milling. A residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. The Li6PS5Cl and Li3PS4 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: GeS2-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a ceramic ion conductor of high conductivity. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. The content of GeS2 is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.8 mS/cm or more. Part of the material is a rare earth halide represented by Li3MCl6, wherein M is yttrium, indium, or scandium, prepared by mechanochemical reaction. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 320 degrees C. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. In an embodiment the material is lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), lithium niobate (LiNbO3), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the high-voltage stability is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 420 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 700 to 850 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A lithium-sulfur battery with the iron sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The iron sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. With 1 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for oxygen with improved response time
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 700 degrees C. The sensor detects oxygen with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
