An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous aluminum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises molybdenum disulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a perovskite-type LLTO ion-conductive solid in which hafnium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The oxide particles have a core of the perovskite-type LLTO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The ion-conductive component may be Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 83% or more. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Amperometric hydrogen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of hydrogen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid electrolyte sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Provided is a sheet in which solid electrolyte particles are held by PTFE fibrils formed by fibrillization during kneading. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state lithium battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The method shortens the process and improves the cycle life and ionic conductivity of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 2.1 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. A dry process in which the solid electrolyte powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state lithium battery. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The additive particles have a size of 200 nm and the critical current density rises from 0.6 mA/cm2 to 3 mA/cm2. A stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and Li3YCl6. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid electrolyte sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a solid electrolyte sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and beta-Li3PS4, and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. With a binder content of 3 wt% and a roll temperature of 120 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 20% or less. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LATP and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A solid-state lithium battery using the sheet shows improved ionic conductivity and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 15 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by solution casting. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 98.5% after 100 cycles. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 300 nm. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 120 nm to 600 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: sulfur positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises sulfur impregnated in ketjen black and a carbon coating on the composite. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. A lithium-sulfur battery with the sulfur cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material sulfur is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiPON layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a protective layer comprising a LiPON inorganic layer and a fluorinated polymer for a lithium metal negative electrode. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The LiPON layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the ion-conductive solid. The inorganic layer is formed by thermal evaporation to a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. After 300 cycles at 0.5 mA/cm2 the cell retains a Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% and no dendrite penetration is observed. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved interfacial resistance and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium phosphorus oxynitride (LiPON) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.25 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and method for preparing the same
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The material comprises Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. A solid-state battery comprising the LLTO and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5 V. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. A residual solvent content of 1 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. The suspension has a solid concentration of 5 wt% to 20 wt% and is reacted at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the solid electrolyte in the solid-state lithium battery. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a solid electrolyte with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting hydrogen
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tungsten stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The sintered body has a relative density of 92%, an average grain size of 10 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a Li7P3S11 phase for lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Crystallization is performed at 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The GeS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 40 hours, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6 and method for preparing the same
abstract: A rare earth metal halide ceramic ion conductor with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. The halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.5 V versus Li/Li+. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a solid-state battery. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The uniaxial pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Germanium-substituted NASICON-type LATP solid electrolyte stable above 4.8 V
abstract: Provided is a NASICON-type LATP solid electrolyte in which germanium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 4.8 V. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 65% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobate and to a method for producing the same. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 8 nm. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. Part of the material is a rare earth halide represented by Li3MCl6, wherein M is yttrium, indium, or scandium, prepared by mechanochemical reaction. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 70 mol% or more of the transition metals. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.8 nm to 40 nm.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The capacity retention of 88% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. With 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Potentiometric ammonia sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of ammonia concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The ammonia sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising sodium beta-alumina, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 8 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 98% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a molybdenum disulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The molybdenum disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase for lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-Li2O glass. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The content of Li2O is 5 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm or more. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 320 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid may comprise beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid shows improved ionic conductivity compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. A hybrid system in which the fuel cell charges a lithium ion battery is also described. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material. When fired at 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 7.2 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: Provided is an orthorhombic halide ceramic ion conductor in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.3 micrometers to 3 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved ionic conductivity and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more.

title: niobium solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor rated at 25 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and iodine. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite phase is 0.08, and the room-temperature conductivity is 7.3 mS/cm. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 1.4 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using ethyl acetate
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in ethyl acetate to give a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and a conductivity of 5 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 4 wt% to 16 wt%.

title: Germanium-substituted phosphate-based NASICON ion-conductive solid stable above 4.8 V and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 4.8 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Suitable compositions include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO).
