The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyethylene oxide based electrolyte of 50 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Method for producing a solid electrolyte sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a solid electrolyte is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The wet film is dried at 60 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% and a viscosity of 2000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, and the dried layer has a thickness of 20 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. The peeling from the release film gives a transferable sheet and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising xylene in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 40 wt% to 60 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The warm isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Slurry composition for an ion-conductive solid layer using a nonpolar solvent and styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of an ion-conductive solid is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. The binder content is 5 wt%, the drying temperature is 60 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the ion-conductive solid does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The peeling from the release film gives a transferable sheet and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 60 wt% to 80 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The warm isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The precipitated Li7P3S11 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Tin-substituted phosphate-based NASICON ion-conductive solid stable above 4.8 V and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 2 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ion-conductive solid. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. Part of the titanium in the phosphate-based NASICON phase is substituted by tin in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved grain boundary resistance at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tantalum stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The LATP and LLTO composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Specific examples are Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). Sintering is performed at 1200 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. Sintering at 1200 degrees C with a lithium excess of 10 mol% gives a relative density of 94% and a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved grain boundary resistance compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.1 <= v <= 0.45, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The polypyrrole is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated therein. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 5.5 mS/cm. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor. A solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of SiS2 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Wet coating method for forming a solid electrolyte layer on a release film and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A wet film of a solid electrolyte cast on a PET release film and dried in an oven is described. The binder content is 1 wt%, the drying temperature is 60 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. In a solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The wet film is dried at 60 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 100 mPa s to 5000 mPa s.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium indium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 30% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-GeS2 glass. The content of GeS2 is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.8 mS/cm or more. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Lithium borate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3BO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li3InCl6. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A precursor of the Li2ZrO3 and Li3InCl6 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the solid-state lithium battery. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 50% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium borate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. With 2 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of sulfur dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide ceramic ion conductor with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and iodine. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 9.6 mS/cm. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The mixed halogen substitution improves the cycle life and electrochemical window of the solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 7.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 75% or more are obtained. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. A solid-state battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an oxygen substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet having a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers and a porosity of 20% or less is provided. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. The sheet has a thickness of 30 micrometers, a porosity of 10%, a tensile strength of 0.5 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.15 MPa or more, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 5 micrometers to 150 micrometers, and wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a platinum electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the sulfur dioxide concentration. The sensor operating at 400 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for sulfur dioxide. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to sulfur dioxide against interfering gases. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The limiting current is proportional to the sulfur dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide solid electrolyte powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material. Heat treatment at 450 degrees C after drying at 150 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 80:20 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The precipitated Li7P3S11 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and lithium battery
abstract: An argyrodite-type solid electrolyte represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. An ionic conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.3 to 0.75. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state battery. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The solid electrolyte provides improved ionic conductivity and cycle life compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75.

title: Argyrodite sulfide ceramic ion conductor with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution
abstract: An argyrodite ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The mixed halogen substitution improves the moisture stability of the all-solid-state lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and method for preparing the same
abstract: An air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte in which hydrolysis is suppressed by arsenic-free antimony substitution is provided. The material comprises Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm and a retention of 85% after humid exposure. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 0.6 mol% to 12 mol%.

assignee_raw: DRIOSTUS ADVANCED MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The content of GeS2 is 5 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.3 mS/cm or more. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved electrochemical window and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 210 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Amperometric hydrogen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising sodium beta-alumina, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1.
