The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 75% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 2 cm3/g. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved grain boundary resistance and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 60% or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The capacity retention of 88% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and production method thereof
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. A solid-state battery comprising the LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 60% to 95% by X-ray diffraction. The glass phase contains P2O5 in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the solid-state battery. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Disclosed is a UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polycarbonate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Silicon-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. Heat treatment at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C gives a conductivity of 2.3 mS/cm and a retention of 80% after humid exposure. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved moisture stability and sinterability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours is 55% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Amperometric carbon dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of carbon dioxide concentration at 700 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. The sensor with a response time of 20 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for carbon dioxide. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for carbon dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The capacity retention of 92% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The warm isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Potentiometric nitrogen oxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide comprises a lanthanum fluoride ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for nitrogen oxide. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising lanthanum fluoride, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, YBr3, and ZrBr4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the electrochemical window and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A solid electrolyte of polyaniline replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. A 8 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which lithium sulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; lithium sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 2 mg/cm2. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing lithium sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the lithium sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The suspension concentration is 5 wt%, the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 120 degrees C. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 70% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 70% or more are obtained. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. The tin substitution amount is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours is 55% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The positive electrode active material is LiCoPO4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide solid electrolyte. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 4.8 V. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polycarbonate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A solid electrolyte of polyaniline replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium indium chloride ion-conductive solid with orthorhombic structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: A halide ion-conductive solid comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6. The median particle diameter D50 is 1 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 2.1 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.3 micrometers to 3 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: Titanium-substituted lithium scandium bromide ceramic ion conductor with monoclinic structure and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The oxidation stability limit is 4.3 V or more and the conductivity is 1.05 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ScBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.05 mS/cm or more.

title: Argyrodite sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the same. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite phase is 0.05, and the room-temperature conductivity is 11.2 mS/cm. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.075 or less. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.05 <= y/a <= 0.55.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The solid electrolyte of scandia-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, fluoroethylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The capacity retention of 90% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tungstate and to a method for producing the same. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and nickel content of 80 mol% or more. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 80% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel.
