The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The material is useful as a solid electrolyte layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The disclosure is applicable to argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30 and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated therein. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The ion-conductive component may be Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the electrochemical window of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which lithium sulfide is confined in the pores of carbon nanotubes to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor operating at 400 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for nitrogen oxide. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyethylene oxide based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Composite cathode comprising titanium disulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Wet coating method for forming an ion-conductive solid layer on a release film and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Described is a slurry composition using a nonpolar solvent that does not react with the sulfide and a binder soluble in the solvent. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 30 micrometers. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the ion-conductive solid, and the layer shows improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Amperometric nitrogen oxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor detects nitrogen oxide with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. The ceramic is lanthanum fluoride and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of nitrogen oxide.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as LiCoPO4. With hafnium substitution of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved grain boundary resistance at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium metal layer, a ceramic ion conductor layer, and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. The Li3YCl6 and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. With the additive in an amount of 1 wt% and a stack pressure of 10 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5%. Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. In an embodiment the material is Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The low electronic conductivity of the Li3YCl6 and Li3PS4 material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. A stack pressure of 5 MPa to 20 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. A solid-state lithium cell using the structure shows improved interfacial resistance and operates at a lower stack pressure.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2 MPa to 50 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte for a solid-state lithium battery has an argyrodite-type crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A dry process in which the solid electrolyte powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state lithium battery. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. Polysulfide dissolution from the iron sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; iron sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. With 0.5 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a ceramic ion conductor of high conductivity. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: niobium solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a silver-containing additive layer
abstract: Disclosed is a dendrite-suppressing structure in which a silver-containing additive at the lithium interface raises the critical current density. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. The critical current density is 1 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 40 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more, and wherein the content of the silver additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and production method thereof
abstract: A Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. The LGPS and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. When fired at 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a solid electrolyte of high conductivity. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li7P3S11 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. After heat treatment at 260 degrees C for 5 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.2 mS/cm. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Solvent-free free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a sheet in which ion-conductive solid particles are held by PTFE fibrils formed by fibrillization during kneading. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The Li6PS5Cl material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. A sheet of 80 micrometers has an areal resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less at 25 degrees C. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 30 degrees C to 90 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The fibrillated binder gives a flexible sheet and improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid in which part of the bromine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. A solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting ammonia
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to ammonia against interfering gases. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The limiting current is proportional to the ammonia concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobium tantalum oxide coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction for lithium battery
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based lithium secondary battery is described. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 350 degrees C. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. The LGPS, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which iron sulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and a conductivity of 5 mS/cm. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 120 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 40 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 40 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.9 wt% or less.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and method for preparing the same
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. A sintering aid comprising LiF is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The grain size is 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and the relative density is 93% or more after sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.31 <= v <= 1.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a thio-LISICON phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing SiS2. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 2.5 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ceramic ion conductor with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 10 mol%. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. Suitable compositions include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The densification improves the mechanical strength and the sinterability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using ethyl acetate and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The LLZO and Li7P3S11 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The LLZO and Li7P3S11 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 4.1 mS/cm. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a ceramic ion conductor with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the all-solid-state battery. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 87% or more. Part of the titanium in the titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase is substituted by germanium in an amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the germanium substitution and the surface region. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The widened electrochemical window improves the sinterability of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLTO, LLZO, and Li2ZrO3 material. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The oxidation potential is 5.2 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 5 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks.
