The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 8 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a Li7P3S11 phase and method for producing the same
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 75:25, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 material. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid shows improved cycle life compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the content of Li2O is 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. Polysulfide dissolution from the iron sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. A lithium-sulfur battery with the iron sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Solid electrolyte slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: Provided is a slurry in which solid electrolyte particles are dispersed in butyl butyrate with a rubber binder and a dispersant. The solid content is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, the viscosity is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the solid electrolyte does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the solid electrolyte in the all-solid-state battery. The Li3YCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The dispersant prevents agglomeration and improves the electrochemical window and moisture stability of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite solid electrolyte having anion disorder and production method thereof
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 2.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tantalate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tantalate and to a method for producing the same. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 10 nm. The material comprises lithium niobate (LiNbO3), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li3InCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region and method for preparing the same
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid in which hydrolysis is suppressed by silicon substitution is provided. Heat treatment at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C gives a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm and a retention of 70% after humid exposure. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the all-solid-state battery. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the moisture stability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 1 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li7P3S11 phase and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a solid electrolyte of high conductivity. The glass phase contains SiS2 in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. A Li6PS5X sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 280 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 70%. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with a lithium secondary battery using it. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li7P3S11 phase precipitates uniformly. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl, LGPS, and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.3 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The ceramic ion conductor shows improved moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid electrolyte whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li2ZrO3 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. With zirconium substitution of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the solid electrolyte layer onto an electrode of the solid-state battery without a drying step. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising sulfur and porous carbon and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises sulfur impregnated in porous carbon and a carbon coating on the composite. The sulfur cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 4 cm3/g or less. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The silicon substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. Heat treatment at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C gives a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm and a retention of 85% after humid exposure. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C is 2 cm3/g. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved sinterability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 75% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less.

title: Potentiometric nitrogen oxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the nitrogen oxide concentration into an ionic activity. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of nitrogen oxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for nitrogen oxide.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. With hafnium substitution of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The Li2ZrO3 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 20 cm3/g or less. The ceramic ion conductor shows an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 10 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the all-solid-state battery. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 10 cm3/g. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a sulfur core and a conductive carbon shell. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; sulfur impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

assignee_db_group: DRIENZ UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The ion-conductive solid is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. A precursor of the Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. A solid-state battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by solution casting
abstract: Provided is a lithiophilic protective layer that improves the wettability of lithium and prevents direct contact between metallic lithium and the sulfide layer. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 200 cycles of stable plating and stripping. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The inorganic layer is formed by solution casting to a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the interfacial resistance of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region and production method thereof
abstract: Provided is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that retains 80% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 1 hours. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The substitution amount is 3 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor. An all-solid-state battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 80% or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Hafnium-substituted perovskite-type LLTO ion-conductive solid stable above 4.5 V and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 4.5 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% or more. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 85% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNbO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiNbO3 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 30% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee_db_group: QUENUNEO TECHNOLOGIES G M B H
title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for an all-solid-state battery has a Li6PS5X crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y). A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The ion-conductive solid provides improved moisture stability and cycle life compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.75.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The warm isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Halogen-rich Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for a lithium secondary battery has a Li6PS5X crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y). Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. An ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.2 to 1.6. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The ion-conductive component may be Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 1.6, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region and all-solid-state battery including the same
