A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The sheet has a thickness of 50 micrometers, a porosity of 10%, a tensile strength of 1 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The method shortens the process and improves the interfacial resistance and sheet formability of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises nickel sulfide impregnated in ketjen black and a carbon coating on the composite. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing P2O5. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The glass phase contains P2O5 in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 240 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 1.2 mS/cm. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a solid-state battery. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a phosphate-based NASICON ion-conductive solid in which germanium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. Part of the titanium in the phosphate-based NASICON phase is substituted by germanium in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the germanium substitution and the surface region. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved grain boundary resistance at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The cold isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. A residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6 and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and LiF material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. Specific examples are Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. When z is 0.1, the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. The titanium substitution in an amount z of 0.02 to 0.25 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6 and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises a trigonal crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 350 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The disclosure is applicable to Li3InCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3YCl6. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a trigonal phase with a conductivity of 0.56 mS/cm or more. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more.

title: Method for forming a solid electrolyte film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a solid electrolyte film without any solvent. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 100 degrees C to form a continuous film. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4. With a binder content of 3 wt% and a roll temperature of 100 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 16% or less. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer comprises ceramic ion conductor particles, a polyisobutylene binder, a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved, and a dispersant. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% and a viscosity of 2000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, and the dried layer has a thickness of 30 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The slurry is applied onto a release film at a coating speed of 1 m/min to 10 m/min and dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C in an oven. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The dispersant prevents agglomeration and improves the sheet formability and interfacial resistance of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 40 wt% to 60 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 650 to 800 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The 1.2 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid with low residual solvent
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from acetonitrile, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. A residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiF layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The material comprises Li3YCl6, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3YCl6. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3YCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved interfacial resistance and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6, wherein z is 0.2 to 0.45, and a method for producing the same are provided. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The halide solid electrolyte is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The polypyrrole is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor and to a lithium battery including the same. A precursor of the LLTO and LATP material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The material comprises Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 94% or more after sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved sinterability compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein 0.1 <= v <= 0.45.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the all-solid-state lithium battery. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The tin substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: An oxide ceramic ion conductor stable against oxidation above 5 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% or more. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. In a solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. Part of the titanium in the titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase is substituted by tin in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. The ceramic ion conductor is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The active material titanium disulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. With 3 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage and method for preparing the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based all-solid-state lithium battery is described. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The Li2ZrO3 and Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium zirconate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide solid electrolyte. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The solid electrolyte may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li3InCl6. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the coated active material shows improved interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 70 mol% or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 1 x 10^-5 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% after 100 cycles. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 500 nm. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The Ag-C layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the ceramic ion conductor. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.2% or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. Polysulfide dissolution from the molybdenum disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 70% or more are obtained. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 10 cm3/g. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours is 70% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyacrylic acid binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The limiting current is proportional to the sulfur dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 8 nm. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.8 nm to 40 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 50 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 90%. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The LLZO and LLTO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. A precursor of the LLZO and LLTO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the grain boundary resistance of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. In the trigonal structure, yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. A precursor of the Li3YCl6, Li3InCl6, and LiF material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.6 micrometers to 6 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating.
