assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Positive electrode active material with lithium yttrium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium yttrium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium yttrium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The ion-conductive solid may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The LiNbO3 and Li2ZrO3 material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering a gallium-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 92% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1200 degrees C, and the resulting density is 95%. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, and wherein 0.05 <= v <= 0.4, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The hydrogen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The solid electrolyte of sodium beta-alumina conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The multilayer structure with the sodium beta-alumina ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor obtained by the method shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polycarbonate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polycarbonate based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The precipitated thio-LISICON phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. The electrode mixture of the solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 75:25, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. A solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved electrochemical window and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 10% to 100%.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using ethyl propionate for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO and Li7P3S11 material. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor obtained by the method shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tungstate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The coating layer has an average thickness of 8 nm and a coverage of 95%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ceramic ion conductor in which hafnium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. In an embodiment the material is lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5.2 V. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ceramic ion conductor. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the sinterability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.6 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 70% or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tantalate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for producing the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based lithium secondary battery is described. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The solid electrolyte may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. A coverage of 95% and a thickness of 10 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 30%. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved moisture stability and electrochemical window compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tantalate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 40% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid and to a lithium battery including the same. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. Specific examples are lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The dopant tantalum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.05 to 0.4, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.05 <= v <= 0.4, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 93% or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: nickel sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyacrylic acid is described. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of scandium and titanium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.3 V. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. When z is 0.4, the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.3 V. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ScBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LiF, Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. In the trigonal structure, scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed bromide sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 material. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less.

title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide ceramic ion conductor comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, InCl3, and ZrCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The oxidation stability limit is 4.3 V or more and the conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The zirconium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, fluoroethylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Lithium borate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium borate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The composition further comprises a lithium metal halide in which the chloride anion sublattice is close-packed, and the halide is synthesized together with the main phase. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The average thickness of the coating is 4 nm to 20 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The ceramic ion conductor shows an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 20 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. Suitable compositions include lithium niobate (LiNbO3), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 80% or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing lithium sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the lithium sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: An oxide ceramic ion conductor stable against oxidation above 5.2 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The ion-conductive component may be Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.9 V or more and a conductivity of 0.21 mS/cm or more. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ceramic ion conductor. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The resulting LLTO and Li2ZrO3 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.6 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 25 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 500 to 650 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The warm isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based all-solid-state battery is described. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and Li3YCl6. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 70 mol% or more of the transition metals. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 20% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. A halide conductor of the hexachloride type with cation disorder forms part of the composition, so that the material is both a coating and a halide conductor. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the high-voltage stability. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as a 5 V spinel. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The oxide ion-conductive solid enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the grain boundary resistance and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The structure with the nickel-plated copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: nickel sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 85% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the interfacial resistance and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 6 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1230 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm and a relative density of 92%. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 84% or more, and wherein 0.11 <= v <= 0.8, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1030 degrees C to 1380 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 94% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. A lithium excess of 10 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A sintering aid comprising LiF is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The total ionic conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The 1.2 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The capacity retention of 88% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
