The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects oxygen.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LGPS and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. An ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.2 to 0.65. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the solid electrolyte is improved. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life and ionic conductivity compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Described is a combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The uniaxial pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide solid electrolyte powder
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from acetonitrile, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The suspension has a solid concentration of 5 wt% to 20 wt% and is reacted at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl, LLZO, and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%.

title: Self-supporting ion-conductive solid sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: An ion-conductive solid sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and an all-solid-state battery including the sheet are described. The LATP and LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. Specific examples are Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). With a binder content of 2 wt% and a roll temperature of 120 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 20% or less. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. The method shortens the process and improves the cycle life and sheet formability of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.6 MPa or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2WO4 and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The Li6PS5Cl, LiNbO3, and Li3InCl6 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tungstate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the solid electrolyte layer onto an electrode of the lithium secondary battery without a drying step. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. A capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The widened electrochemical window improves the ionic conductivity of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 70% or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The capacity retention of 85% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. With 1 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: An air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte in which hydrolysis is suppressed by oxygen substitution is provided. After exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the grain boundary resistance and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The roll pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Lithium tungstate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state battery is described. In an embodiment the material is lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6 material. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 10 nm. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Part of the material is a rare earth halide represented by Li3MCl6, wherein M is yttrium, indium, or scandium, prepared by mechanochemical reaction. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Positive electrode active material with lithium borate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The LiNbO3, Li3InCl6, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 10 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of erbium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of erbium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.3 V. The disclosure is applicable to Li3InCl6. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.3 micrometers to 3 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.2 to 0.45. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.2 to 0.45 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the ionic conductivity at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder for lithium battery
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LLZO material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The ion-conductive solid obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 4.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt%. The ion-conductive solid is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 120 degrees C to 300 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the nitrogen oxide concentration. The nitrogen oxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The auxiliary electrode comprises barium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: Dendrite-suppressing silver additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell
abstract: A lithium metal interface with uniform nucleation and suppressed dendrite penetration along grain boundaries is described. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The critical current density at 25 degrees C is 2 mA/cm2 and the cell survives 500 cycles of plating and stripping without short circuit. The additive comprises silver in an amount of 0.2 wt% to 1 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The suppression of void formation improves the cycle life during fast charging.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 4 MPa to 100 MPa, and wherein the content of the silver additive is 0.05 wt% to 2.5 wt%.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a phosphate-based NASICON ceramic ion conductor in which zirconium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The substitution amount is 5 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.5 V or more and a conductivity of 0.21 mS/cm or more. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The oxide particles have a core of the phosphate-based NASICON phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in zirconium. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The positive electrode active material is LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ceramic ion conductor. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the ionic conductivity of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium difluorophosphate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. With 0.5 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for a solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x). Firing is performed at 500 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm. Specific examples are Li7P3S11. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved moisture stability compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARHC INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARHC INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: This disclosure concerns an additive that alloys with lithium during plating and prevents short circuit through the ceramic ion conductor. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. A stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The additive particles have a size of 200 nm and the critical current density rises from 0.6 mA/cm2 to 1 mA/cm2. The suppression of void formation improves the ionic conductivity and cycle life during fast charging.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 60 cycles or more.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure provides a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The solid electrolyte provides improved moisture stability compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The Li3InCl6, Li2ZrO3, and LiNbO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.3 <= a <= 1.7, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ceramic ion conductor whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The Li3PS4 and LGPS material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.075 or less. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.95, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The lithium secondary battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The material comprises Li7P3S11 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7P3S11 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 5 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Sintering at 1150 degrees C with a lithium excess of 15 mol% gives a relative density of 95% and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. A sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium borate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
