A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. After exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 60% or more.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The capacity retention of 88% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. With 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air for lithium battery
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The electrode mixture of the all-solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Heat treatment at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1 mS/cm and a retention of 90% after humid exposure. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 50 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3YCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium yttrium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6 material. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6) and has an average thickness of 6 nm to 30 nm and a coverage of 85% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 15 nm. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

assignee_raw: UNIVERSITY OF SELEXEN INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: UNIVERSITY OF SELEXEN INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite-type crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x). Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. A precursor of the Li3PS4 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. An ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.2 to 0.65. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: Provided is a lithiophilic protective layer that improves the wettability of lithium and prevents direct contact between metallic lithium and the sulfide layer. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A halide coating is compatible with the solid electrolyte because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99% after 100 cycles. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 120 nm to 600 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: An argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y) and a method for producing the same are described. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The argyrodite-type phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The Li3PS4, LGPS, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the iodine-substituted argyrodite-type shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein 1.4 <= a <= 1.8.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. A residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. The LLZO and Li7P3S11 material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tantalate and to a method for producing the same. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. Nickel accounts for 70 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 300 degrees C. The LiNbO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyethylene oxide and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: An ion-conductive solid sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a solid-state battery including the sheet are described. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The tensile strength is 0.3 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11, and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid. A solid-state battery using the sheet shows improved moisture stability and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as a 5 V spinel. An all-solid-state lithium battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5.2 V. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ion-conductive solid layer onto an electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery without a drying step. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The widened electrochemical window improves the electrochemical window of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 10 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a ceramic ion conductor film without any solvent. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The LLZO and LATP material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The sheet has a thickness of 30 micrometers, a porosity of 10%, a tensile strength of 1 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and production method thereof
abstract: A method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting, drying, and peeling from a support film is provided. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. The ceramic ion conductor can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The binder content is 5 wt%, the drying temperature is 100 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% to 70 wt% and a viscosity of 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Because the binder is dissolved in the solvent, the layer is uniform and shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 80 degrees C to 120 degrees C.

title: Arsenic-free antimony-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 20 cm3/g or less. After exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 material. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise beta-Li3PS4. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours is 45% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in tetrahydrofuran to give a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte is preferably argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the sinterability of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as LiCoPO4. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. Examples of the ion conductor include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The oxide particles have a core of the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 83% or more. In a solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. Part of the titanium in the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase is substituted by hafnium in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.35 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium nitrite that converts the hydrogen concentration into an ionic activity. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Ion-conductive solid sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and a porosity of 20% or less is provided. A precursor of the Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The synthesis comprises reacting the raw materials in a suspension with stirring and removing the residual solvent before the sheet is formed. No solvent is used in the process, so the ion-conductive solid does not react with a polar solvent and retains its conductivity. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The method shortens the process and improves the sheet formability of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises iron sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The confinement of iron sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: Described is a lithium erbium chloride ion-conductive solid prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. When z is 0.4, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, ErCl3, and TiCl4 followed by heat treatment at 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3InCl6. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of indium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a monoclinic halide solid electrolyte in which indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.1 to 0.35. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The halide is applied to the positive electrode active material by a wet coating with an alkoxide-free solution, giving a coated cathode. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The ion-conductive component may be Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The material comprises Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the moisture stability at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polyaniline layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The equivalent series resistance is 20 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. With 2 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. A hybrid system in which the fuel cell charges a lithium ion battery is also described. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a NASICON-type LATP ion-conductive solid in which tin substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The decomposition current density at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 75% or more. In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. The oxide particles have a core of the NASICON-type LATP phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in tin.
