title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich Li6PS5X phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.15 or less. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The Li6PS5X phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.95, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 680 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. Suitable compositions include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure. Heat treatment at 500 degrees C after drying at 120 degrees C gives a conductivity of 2.9 mS/cm or more. The low residual solvent suppresses the decrease in conductivity caused by carbon-containing impurities and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide ion-conductive solid comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6. The Li3YCl6 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 80 degrees C to 320 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2ZrO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide solid electrolyte. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3InCl6 and LiF material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li3InCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 60% relative to uncoated particles. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. The total ionic conductivity is 0.56 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and lithium fluoride (LiF). A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state battery using it. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. A precursor of the Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. A halide coating is compatible with the solid electrolyte because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The content of GeS2 is 3 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.8 mS/cm or more. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte shows improved electrochemical window and cycle life compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and method for preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 75% or more and an average thickness of 4 nm to 20 nm is provided. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. A coverage of 80% and a thickness of 10 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The high coverage of the coating results in improved cycle life at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 15 micrometers. The LLZO and Li6PS5Cl material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The peeling from the release film gives a transferable sheet and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which nickel sulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for producing a solid electrolyte sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: Described is a slurry composition using a nonpolar solvent that does not react with the sulfide and a binder soluble in the solvent. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The particles have a median diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and the layer has a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 60 wt% to 80 wt%.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and production method thereof
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ion-conductive solid having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the iodine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 1.4 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6 and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a halide solid electrolyte in which hafnium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium chloride framework. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. In the orthorhombic structure, yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.5 V versus Li/Li+. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The resulting Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The hafnium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte in which part of the bromine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiBr and Li3PS4. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The Li3PS4, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The resulting Li3PS4, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 6 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6 and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a trigonal halide ceramic ion conductor in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. A coating layer of the halide on the active material lowers the interfacial resistance with the sulfide, and the coverage is determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. When z is 0.2, the conductivity is 2.1 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.2 V. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ion-conductive solid whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.045 or less. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 90% or more and an average thickness of 3.2 nm to 16 nm is provided. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The Li3InCl6 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-P2O5 glass. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl material. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. The precipitated beta-Li3PS4 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C.

title: Amperometric hydrogen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of barium carbonate that converts the hydrogen concentration into an ionic activity. The sensor with a response time of 10 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for hydrogen. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the sodium beta-alumina ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The hydrogen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of hydrogen.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: LiI-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 280 degrees C. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved moisture stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 100%, and wherein the content of LiI is 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution
abstract: An ion-conductive solid comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the moisture stability of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.2 V. After dehydration under vacuum at 250 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 130 degrees C to 370 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises lithium sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing Li2O. The content of Li2O is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the lithium secondary battery. The Li3PS4 and LGPS material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of scandium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Described is a lithium scandium chloride ceramic ion conductor prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3YCl6, LiF, and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. A precursor of the Li3YCl6, LiF, and Li3InCl6 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives an orthorhombic phase with a conductivity of 1.47 mS/cm or more. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved ionic conductivity and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which scandium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3InCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li3InCl6 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 50 mol% or more of the transition metals. The Li6PS5Cl, LiNbO3, and Li2ZrO3 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. Examples of the ion conductor include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 330 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sulfur dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the sulfur dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide comprises a lanthanum fluoride ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 400 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Arsenic-free antimony-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and production method thereof
abstract: Provided is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that retains 70% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.1 mS/cm or more. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved moisture stability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours is 70% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic Ag-C layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium.
